name: signed-url-expiry-p5
prompt: how do I hand out a temporary download link to a private file that stops working after a short time

chunks.content: log every file access request with the requester id for the audit trail
the product catalog cache holds entries for 10 minutes and busts on any write
softened the page transitions with a 150ms fade so navigation feels less jarring
added an index on (user_id, created_at) to speed up the activity feed
the welcome email goes out through the transactional provider after signup
ramp the new uploader UI to 10% of users behind a flag
format currency to the buyer's locale in the checkout summary
export request latency histograms to the metrics backend every 15 seconds
switched the report list to keyset pagination on the last seen id
an idle login session expires after 30 minutes and the user is bounced to the sign-in page
decided to serve private attachments through a pre-signed object-storage link that embeds an expiry timestamp and a signature, so the URL is only valid for a brief window
moved cold archive files to an infrequent-access storage tier to cut costs
the temporary link grants access to exactly that one object and can't be used to browse or enumerate other files in the bucket
the link's lifetime is set to five minutes, just long enough for the browser to start the download, after which the storage layer rejects it as expired
because the path and expiry are HMAC-signed with our secret, a client can't extend the deadline or point the link at someone else's file without invalidating it
